source: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
endpoint: held-out pass@1 change from the common base model below zero percentage points
chronology: retrospective risk rule reconstructed after publication from features available before training
feature_timing: training-environment audit status and target-distribution relationship do not use trained-policy outcomes

risk_rule.definition: Risk is highest when reward labels lack execution-backed auditing and the held-out benchmark changes language, scaffold, and budget relative to training; unaudited labels without that additional shift receive intermediate risk.

claim_boundary: source-contained association across 24 seed-by-target outcomes, not a cross-study coding regression model
the two targets are nested under one released training experiment and are not independent interventions
the risk rule requires testing on a new coding intervention before prospective use
